Type: Persian-style medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a sofa or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, bohemian
Materials: low-pile woven synthetic
Colors: brick red, gold, cream, sage green
Shape: rectangular, central ornate medallion on red field, floral motifs, wide multiple borders, large

Goes with: cream sofas, warm wood floors, white walls; traditional or farmhouse rooms

product.description: 100% Polypropylene Imported Get the look of classic opulence with modern durability in this Persian style rug. Antique look with contemporary functionality Machine woven.
